text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: There's a real chill runnin' through my tail...
text_block_list.orig_text:
尻尾が
ざわざわしますなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Feels like we're being watched from all over!
We're like a deer in headlights!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこら中から見られてる感じだよ～！
蛇に睨まれた蛙、
ってやつかな～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Heh. A deer, huh?
How about we show these Majimun
just how tough Caon can be?
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ。
あたしらが蛙ってタマかよ。
マジムンどもに見せつけてやろうぜ、
【自警団（カォン）】の力をよ！
